llm_response.reason: The website displays several scam indicators: it claims to sell branded goods (Souleiado, Luis Lara) without proving any legitimate connection, does not provide explicit business contacts or company information, lacks a clear privacy or legal policy, and applies typical e-commerce category structuring with heavy promotion of discounts. This combination is characteristic of fake online shopping sites designed to mimic well-known brands and trick customers into purchases without delivering goods.
